edit.description: the bare arm reports a wrap through the set the fenced arm already reports into
fixture wrap at a directory boundary whose tail a root-level page answers

summary: Report an unfenced *.md cite a comment line breaks, rather than judging the tail the break leaves behind
acceptance: A bare page cite split by a line break is reported as a wrap and judged by nothing; the existing repo wrap pin covers both fencings.
tests: the citation scan reports an unfenced page name broken across a comment line
the citation scan judges no tail an unfenced page name's line break left behind
notes: Measured on the current helper: a comment wrapping `docs/` + `guide.md` is judged as `guide.md` alone — a name the author never wrote, dangling under the wrong cite, and resolving silently whenever a root-level page answers the tail (root holds README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CLAUDE.md). The fenced arm already detects the wrap; share it rather than spell a second rule (engineering.md, *The fix lands at the mechanism*). A comment line ending in `/` is the break prose never makes.
